feature_name: Cloud Run remote functions for Spanner GoogleSQL queries
summary: Spanner can call user-defined remote functions hosted on Cloud Run directly from GoogleSQL queries.
extended_definition: Spanner can call user-defined remote functions hosted on Cloud Run directly from GoogleSQL queries.
